# Budgeting that never leaves your machine.

Pulse Local is a complete budgeting app, with a chat that answers from your own figures.

Other apps keep your ledger on their servers, or send your questions to someone else's model. We keep both on your machine.

## “Local” usually means your data. Not your question.

Your ledger sits on your disk. Then you ask something, and the question plus the rows that answer it go to a hosted model.

## Local mode is global. Local is global. Sync is US, for now.

Pick your country once and the ledger is kept in your currency, any of the world’s. Every figure is written the way you write it, 1.234,56 € in Berlin and ¥1,311 in Tokyo, and a bank file from anywhere imports: day-first dates, decimal commas, a header in your own language picked by hand. Nothing is converted, ever. The app answers in English. Pick your country once and the ledger is kept in your currency, any of the world’s; every figure is written the way you write it, and a bank file from anywhere imports. Bank sync runs through Plaid, which covers US banks for now: everywhere else, stay in Local mode and import a CSV. The app answers in English.
